settings.label: Reveal direction
settings.info: Side the second image comes in from

settings.content: A badge only shows when the product qualifies, in this order: Best seller, New, Sale, Metaobject badges.

settings.label: Sold out
settings.info: Sold-out products show only this badge (top right of the image), faded, and the image is dimmed.

settings.label: Metaobject badges
settings.info: One badge per metaobject in a product metafield (e.g. Fair Trade, Low Impact)

settings.label: Metafield key
settings.info: From Settings > Metafields and metaobjects > Products

settings.label: Metaobject field to show
settings.info: Leave blank to use label, name or title

settings.label: Max width (desktop)
settings.info: Badges wrap to a new line beyond this width

settings.label: Badge on mobile and tablet
settings.info: Only one badge fits on the image on small screens. If the product doesn't have it, its first badge shows. On mobile Best seller shows under the image instead.

settings.content: Read from product metafields: custom.impact_score, custom.water_usage and custom.carbon_footprint.

settings.label: Material / product type
settings.info: custom.material metafield, or the product type

settings.label: Tags to hide
settings.info: Comma-separated, e.g. internal, sale-2025. Tags used for the Best seller and New badges are hidden automatically.

settings.label: Discount note
settings.info: e.g. 52% off (price as marked), on sale products

settings.label: Badge and tag spacing
settings.info: Space between badges on the image and between product tags
